risk_summary: A high-severity geopolitical event (“Export licence suspension on rare-earth concentrate, indefinite”) has disrupted Altiplano Rare Earth (Neodymium magnet billet), a single-source supplier with no qualified alternate. The disruption propagates to 5 downstream suppliers: Shenzhen Micro Sensors (Manifold pressure sensor array), Great Lakes Stamping (Stamped steel mounting bracket), Delta Assembly Works (Turbocharger subassembly), and 2 more. Principal concerns are 3 single-source dependencies in the affected path and 3 suppliers already flagged on compliance.
